scoring_justification: The scaling rule for second-neighbor overlap parameters is not uniquely defined in the paper; different implementations lead to different absolute band energies. A T1 recompute (MAE against a reference computed with a specific scaling) is not robust, as a correct implementation with a different scaling choice would fail. Instead, T3 structural checks on the band structure's qualitative physical features are employed.

outputs.description: Computed electronic band energies for all four bands and three geometries (linear, helix125, helix50).

checks.name: k_grid_sufficiency
checks.description: Each geometry must have at least 200 unique k points.

checks.name: linear_degeneracy
checks.description: For the linear chain, the two middle bands (bands 1 and 2) must be degenerate (max allowed deviation 1e-4 eV) at every k point.

checks.name: helix125_splitting
checks.description: At k≈0 for helix125, the two p-derived bands must show a splitting between 0.04 eV and 0.06 eV (the hallmark ~50 meV splitting).

checks.name: helix50_larger_splitting
checks.description: At k≈0 for helix50, the splitting between the two p-derived bands must be larger than the corresponding splitting in helix125.
